# ARG Software

> ARG Software is an architecture-first software engineering company based in Portugal, Europe. Its senior-led team builds production-ready systems for fintech, SaaS and high-growth technology companies worldwide.

## What We Do

- Dedicated product teams for long-term product engineering
- Senior team extension with experienced engineers
- Technical consulting for architecture reviews, scalability planning, modernization, and delivery strategy
- MVP and product delivery for production-ready first releases
- AI integration for product features, workflows, and reliable software capabilities
- Cloud and platform engineering, including CI/CD, observability, deployments, and reliability work

## Industries

- Fintech and open payments
- Financial inclusion and interoperable payment systems
- Music technology and music rights
- Media and entertainment platforms
- Web3 and blockchain infrastructure
- SaaS, internal platforms, and high-growth technology products

## Technical Focus

- Backend systems, APIs, distributed systems, and event-driven architecture
- Frontend and product interfaces with React, Next.js, Angular, React Native, Vue, and TypeScript
- Payment switching, ledgers, interoperability, Open Payments, Interledger, and Mojaloop vNext
- Cloud infrastructure, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, observability, and production operations
- Serverless functions, AWS, Azure, GCP, Scaleway, Supabase, Vercel, and Netlify
- Databases and messaging with PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, Kafka, RabbitMQ, and related tooling
